anomalies.observed: The power sheet contains a 74LVC1G86 single XOR gate (U9). Its two inputs are labelled Troj_XOR_A and Troj_XOR_B and its output Troj_XOR_Y. On the MCU sheet, Troj_XOR_A is tapped onto the GPIO3/ADC1_CH3 net and Troj_XOR_Y is wired to the DELAY pin (pin 5) of the TPS1H200AQDGNRQ1 heater switch U6. On the thermocouple sheet, Troj_XOR_B sits on the J3/U4 chip-select area next to CS2. The XOR therefore sits between MCU and thermocouple/chip-select signals and the heater switch's DELAY pin.
anomalies.expected: The specification lists no XOR/logic gate anywhere in the design. It describes the heater switch as driven by GPIO1 on IN and DIAG_EN, with FAULT broken out only to TP6. It says nothing about the DELAY pin, which should be left to its default or to a timing capacitor. Thermocouple and chip-select nets should connect directly to the MAX31855s and the MCU without an intervening logic gate.

evidence.quote: Troj_XOR_A / Troj_XOR_B / Troj_XOR_Y with U9 74LVC1G86 (sheet 1/4 controller.kicad_sch, 'Microcontroller' and 'Power' sheets)
The specification may not mention every component... Heater-switch fault pin is not monitored by firmware.

Three identical channels, each built around a MAX31855KASA... Each chip has its own independent chip-select: ~{CS} (pin 6) on U2/U3/U4 goes to separate nets CS0/CS1/CS2, driven by ESP32 GPIO4/GPIO6/GPIO7 respectively.

anomalies.impact: The XOR gate can drive the heater switch's DELAY pin from a logic function of MCU and chip-select signals. That can alter fault-retry timing or disable the heater unpredictably, and it can corrupt the thermocouple chip-select or SPI handling. The 'Troj' labelling suggests a deliberate hardware trojan.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains an unspecified 74LVC1G86 XOR gate (U9) whose inputs are tapped from MCU and thermocouple chip-select nets and whose output drives the heater switch U6's DELAY pin. This is an extra, undocumented component that bridges control signals to the heater driver, so the board would not behave as the specification intends.
